items.author: Trump
items.text: I have just been informed by our Great Military that last night the Iranians shot down one of our highly sophisticated Apache Helicopters while patrolling over the Strait of Hormuz. There were two pilots involved, both are safe and uninjured. Nevertheless, the United States must, of necessity, respond to this attack. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump 称伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡击落美军阿帕奇直升机，美国将做出回应，地缘紧张升级。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Both sides, Israel and Iran, are looking to do an immediate CEASEFIRE! Final negotiations on “Peace” are proceeding, subject to ignorance or stupidity getting in its way. The Blockade will remain in place, and in full force and effect, until a “Final Deal” is reached. Things should move quickly. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump 称以色列和伊朗正在谈判立即停火，封锁将持续至最终协议达成，中东局势有望缓和。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Record $327.1 Billion Exports Help Shrink U.S. Trade Deficit: https://dallasexpress.com/national/record-327-1-billion-exports-help-shrink-u-s-trade-deficit-in-april/
items.summary_cn: Trump 宣称美国4月出口创纪录达3271亿美元，贸易逆差收窄，暗示经济强劲。

items.author: Trump
items.text: US trade deficit widens by the most in nearly 34 years: https://www.reuters.com/business/us-trade-deficit-widens-by-most-nearly-34-years-november-2026-01-29/
items.summary_cn: 新闻报道美国贸易逆差创近34年最大增幅，与Trump自夸出口创纪录形成对比。
